## Earnie 2.5.0-alpha.2

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5** line (follow-up to `2.5.0-alpha.1`). Focus: Chart-1 / QH correctness and matched baseline scaling.

### Highlights

- **Chart 1 QH prices** — Preis/Einspeisepreis as per-slot HV steps (no hourly collapse on QH tariffs)
- **Chart 1 MILP tail** — after Ist, prefer exact QH sim rows when `now.minute ≥ 15` (no empty gap)
- **BL Ziel €/kW** — exclude `live_snapshot` from matched-baseline profile shape (no `target/dt_h` ×4 spike)
- **Verified** — phantom Kochen / missing battery export (history Ist skip known peel)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0-alpha.2` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.4.0**).
